scope: Implementation verification on reused development inputs; not a final research question, hypothesis, complete student experimental design, independent geology, confirmation, or competition proof. Outcomes/timings must not be run without separate root authorization and student ownership determination.

geometry.mapping: integer factor2: (old_coord+1)*2-1; C-order flatten on49 grid

preparation.refinement: RegularGridInterpolator linear on edge-padded26x26 velocity with coordinates0..25; new interior nodes1..49 mapped to old-coordinate j*25/50; no clipping
preparation.initialization: Gaussian filter refined velocity sigma.08km/.025km=3.2 grid cells, reflect; then reciprocal-square
preparation.truth: same fine discrete reference solver on reciprocal-square refined raw velocity; noiseless self-consistent observations; all truth-data generation outside online clock and separately counted

ancestry: All8 already reused development slices; nominal SEAM model IDs share ancestor. No independent-parent/site/IID confidence claims; every run retained.
gmres_role: Same paid LU merit for all5 methods. GMRES solves only missing Lambda/V using same coarse-Galerkin initializer and same norm-free inverse action as fixed sweeps. Convergence requires true residual for every column. No certificate SVD/eig paid by GMRES. Failed GMRES trajectory and all reports/costs retained; no nonconverged field returned.
target_role: Reporting endpoints only; neither ratio stops the online algorithm. First within-budget strict accepted checkpoint achieving ratio; unreached targets remain censored, never replaced with elapsed budget.
order: repetition outer, fixed identity order, independent rng.default_rng(order_seed).permutation(methods) per case/repetition; save all120 scheduled runs before execution
online_rule: Fresh oracle/physics/proxy/stability per policy/case/repetition; constructor/setup+initialLUmerit+allcurrentmodelwork+alltrials+fallbacks+policy metadata construction and acceptance paid. Final strict serialization/artifact compression and offline numerical audits are outside the algorithm clock. Only strict accepted endpoints completed within budget credited. A raw point certificate does not certify clipping or a finite step.
offline_rule: Generate shared truth data before controls; independent fresh-LU endpoint verification and certificate-DD audits after each timed trajectory, never passed to policy. Record offline costs/time separately.
cache_rule: Within-run current+latest LU receipts, own norm-free modelcache4/contextcache8 and own stability modelcache4; no cross-policy or cross-run fields/contexts/warm starts.
execution_gate: No project-study runner or execution CLI is supplied. This archived AI-authored software candidate is unapproved; root GO and student ownership determination are required before any future project execution.
artifact_rule: New output directory only; status written before work, every scheduled run/failure retained. Gzipped JSON hashes/time/Phi/cost histories without duplicate dense vectors; compressed NPZ initial/budget/final models only. Offline audits use in-RAM full trajectory before releasing it. Explicit disk preflight. No timings hidden/pooled as IID; no selecting a winner as confirmation.
statistics: Per-run paired raw endpoints and target times; descriptive case/nominal-parent summaries only, no IID eight-slice CI or geology-independent inference.
numerical_scope: Float64/complex128 ordinary FP. Coarse inequalities use existing unverified allowances, no formal roundoff enclosure, finite-step safety theorem, or acceleration promise.
design_status: Unapproved AI-authored engineering defaults; not the student final or complete experiment design.
